sloka: एष देव दशग्रीवः प्राप्तो गन्तुं त्रिविष्टपम् ।तेन सैन्यसहायेन निशेयं परिणामिता ।। ७.२६.४८ ॥
transliteration: eṣa deva daśagrīvaḥ prāpto gantuṁ triviṣṭapam ।tena sainyasahāyena niśeyaṁ pariṇāmitā ।। 7.26.48 ॥

translations.english: O god, this Dashagriva arrived here to go to heaven, and with the help of his army, he spent this night.
